changelog: Hold-off script line breaks written in the editor now show in the banner (was collapsing to one paragraph)

Service area: addresses outside the area we're booking right now raise a warning on the address bar, with a polite hold-off script and a Copy button. It warns, it does not block, so you can still book if you know something the map doesn't

Service area boundaries are drawn on a map at speed-to-leads.vercel.app/service-area.html and reach every scanner within a minute. The script and the on/off switch live there too. Options has a per-profile switch to silence the warning
